fit_reason: Whole pontoon boat with motor and trailer listed by a private owner.
findings: Light spotting and dulling on the rear seat back panels near the motor
Dirty, discolored pontoon tubes at the stern
Some grime and staining on the lower vinyl seat bases and corners in the bow seating area
Dull, faded finish on the cream helm console and rear seat shells
Carpet looks a bit dusty in the bow and center deck
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Palm Beach pontoon. The seating and carpet look good overall, but the stern tubes and the lower vinyl panels show some grime that a pre-sale detail would clean up. We come to you and can do a full wash, vinyl and carpet clean, and tube cleanup. Would you like a quote?
